notes: §2002:14.8.23.3 GR4: equal-key records follow the MERGE statement's USING order (a), and each file's ties precede the next file's (b). Two MERGEs of the same three files, one a FORMAT CHARACTER DATA file, in the orders F2 F1 F3 and F3 F1 F2, print the 18 derived lines; the pinned build matched them at --std 2002.
